fluff.overview: The Capellan Confederation has always relied on its infantry to compensate for the CCAF's chronic shortage of heavier assets. Conventional foot soldiers, drawn from the citizens' militia system that defines Capellan military service, form the backbone of garrison forces across the Confederation's commonalities. Hover-mechanized platoons are the fastest infantry formation in the CCAF, using hovercraft transports capable of crossing water and open ground at speeds that tracked and wheeled vehicles cannot match. Their speed makes them effective scouts and flanking elements, though the hover transports themselves are fragile. Equipped with laser rifles that offer superior range and armor penetration compared to ballistic weapons, these platoons field one of the most effective personal arms available to conventional infantry, though the weapons are significantly more expensive and require soldiers to carry additional power packs.
